description: The content of config.yaml; every field is optional.

additionalProperties.description: Holds the defaults for one agent.

api_key.description: The agent's API key, written here. Set at most one of api_key, api_key_env and api_key_file; config.yaml must then not be readable by other users. A subscription login in the project is kept.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable on this computer that holds the agent's API key.

api_key_file.description: A file on this computer that holds the agent's API key.

effort.description: The reasoning effort `codeflower task` asks for (the agent's thought level, e.g. low, medium or high).

model.description: The model `codeflower task` asks the agent for, as the agent names it; the task stops when the agent has no such model.

options.description: Other settings of the agent for `codeflower task`, by the ids the agent gives them (as with `--option ID=VALUE`).

agents.description: Settings of each agent, by its id.

connect_only.description: Never start sandboxes here, e.g. on a login node.

notifications.description: Tell the desktop when a chat waits for an answer or ends its turn (default true).

tray.description: Show an icon in the system tray or menu bar where there is one (default true).

wrap_up_minutes.description: How long quitting waits at most for the chats in the client's sandboxes to wrap up (default 10).

engine.description: Auto, docker, podman or apptainer, for the sandboxes the command line starts when neither --engine nor $CODEFLOWER_ENGINE is set.

image.description: The sandbox image (a Docker/Podman image name or an Apptainer .sif file) for the sandboxes the command line starts when neither --image nor $CODEFLOWER_IMAGE is set.

images.description: Configures the image model codeflower-sketch generates icons with.

api_key.description: The provider's API key, written here (at most one of api_key, api_key_env and api_key_file).

api_key_env.description: The environment variable on this computer that holds the key.

api_key_file.description: A file on this computer that holds the key.

provider.description: Openai or google. An isolated sandbox may reach its API.

isolate_network.description: Start the command line's sandboxes as with --isolate-network.

additionalProperties.description: A Model Context Protocol server the agent of every sandbox may use: a command that runs in the sandbox (stdio), or a server at a URL.

command.description: The program that runs the server in the sandbox (stdio).

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to a server at a URL, e.g. Authorization.

transport.description: Of a server at a URL: http (streamable HTTP, the default) or sse, which Codex and dsh do not support.

url.description: The address of a server that runs elsewhere, instead of a command.

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers given to the agent of every sandbox, by name.

items.description: One of an agent's own plugins under plugins: (docs/plugins.md).

enabled.description: Defaults to true; a project can switch an entry off.

source.description: Agent-neutral: marketplace:NAME@CATALOG, github:OWNER/REPO[#REF], git:URL[#REF], npm:PACKAGE@VERSION, url:https://….zip|.tgz[#sha256=…] or path:/absolute; each agent takes the kinds its descriptor names.

plugins.description: The agents' own plugins every sandbox gets, by agent id.

skills.description: More folders of skills, mounted read-only in every sandbox besides <config dir>/skills; relative paths are in the config directory.

tunnel.description: Configures remote access through a code flower tunnel (`codeflower tunnel login`).

eu_only.description: Routes the tunnel only through EU datacenters. Unset until the first `codeflower tunnel login` asks.

hardened.description: Limits each paired browser to the workers chosen when pairing, and runs the connector as a separate, confined process.

manage.description: Lets remote browsers browse folders, start sandboxes and forget them; without it they use and stop existing sandboxes only.

url.description: The tunnel; the hosted one when empty.

title: code flower config.yaml
